title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover the best social spaces and activities at Dominican University that require no admission fee or purchase, from historic reading rooms to outdoor concerts.

cards.title: Study in the Noonan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: A historic quiet space in Lewis Hall
cards.notes: Visit the second floor of Lewis Hall to study in this classic, wood-paneled room. It is a designated quiet zone perfect for focused reading or homework between classes.
cards.short_summary: The Noonan Reading Room is a historic, quiet study space located on the second floor of Lewis Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Noonan Reading Room is described as a perfect atmosphere to read and do homework, located on the second floor of Lewis Hall, and is listed as a study area available to students.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; accessible to all students for quiet study.

cards.title: Browse the O'Connor Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Contemporary art on the fourth floor of Lewis Hall
cards.notes: Explore rotating contemporary art exhibitions and annual student shows. The gallery is free and open to the public Monday through Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: The O'Connor Art Gallery hosts contemporary art exhibitions and is free and open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery is open to the public during the academic year, Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., and is free for all visitors.

cards.title: Reflect at the Grotto
cards.subtitle: A peaceful outdoor retreat since 1929
cards.notes: Find a quiet moment at this historic stone grotto in the northwest corner of campus. It features a waterfall, seating, and a statue of St. Bernadette.
cards.short_summary: The Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto is a historic outdoor space for prayer and reflection on the River Forest campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grotto is a place of prayer, reflection, and peace for the university community and neighborhood, featuring new plantings and a brick platform for benches.
cards.source_title: The Grotto: A Place of Prayer and Peace for Nearly a Century | Dominican University

cards.title: Attend a Summer Sounds Concert
cards.subtitle: Free outdoor music on the Quad
cards.notes: Bring a blanket to the Quad on Wednesday nights during the summer for free live music. Performances range from Latin jazz to 90s tribute bands.
cards.short_summary: Summer Sounds is a series of free weekly outdoor concerts held on the Dominican University Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Summer Sounds '26 features free music every Wednesday from June 10 to August 12 on the quad, weather permitting.
cards.access_notes: Wednesdays at 7:00 pm during the summer season.

cards.title: Celebrate at DU Fest
cards.subtitle: Annual back-to-school festival on the Quad
cards.notes: Join the campus community on the Quad for this annual festival featuring food trucks, live music, and free activities to kick off the academic year.
cards.short_summary: DU Fest is a free annual festival for students held on the Quad during Welcome Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: DU Fest is a free event for all DU Students on the Quad, including food trucks, live music, and free activities.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend - River Forest Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Sunday afternoon of Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Hang Out in the Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Social and study hub in the library
cards.notes: Use the first and second floors of the library for group study or social gathering. The space includes reservable study rooms and comfortable seating.
cards.short_summary: The Learning Commons in the Rebecca Crown Library provides social and gathering spaces for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons houses centralized services, study rooms, social and gathering spaces on the 1st and 2nd floors of the library.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; Star Card required for some services.

cards.title: Relax in the Parmer Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern light-filled space in Parmer Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this central atrium that overlooks a courtyard. It serves as a hub for the science departments and offers a bright space for student connection.
cards.short_summary: The Shaffer Silveri Atrium is a central gathering space within Parmer Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Parmer Hall features the Shaffer Silveri Atrium on the first floor, which overlooks a courtyard and serves as a central hub.

cards.title: Watch a Show at Lund Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Free tickets for Dominican students
cards.notes: Claim up to two free tickets for university-presented performing arts or theatre shows. Shows include musical acts, dance parties, and mariachi performances.
cards.short_summary: Dominican University students receive free admission to most Performing Arts Center events.
cards.evidence_claim: DU Students are entitled to 2 free tickets per DU Performing Arts or Theatre Arts Show at the Lund Auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Student ID required; tickets must be reserved through the box office.

cards.title: Join the Día de los Muertos Procession
cards.subtitle: Annual cultural celebration and ofrendas
cards.notes: Participate in the annual procession with mariachis to bless campus ofrendas. The event concludes with a convivencia, a festive shared meal.
cards.short_summary: The Día de los Muertos celebration is an annual campus event featuring processions and community altars.
cards.evidence_claim: Dominican gathers each year for a Día de los Muertos celebration with a procession, mariachis, and a convivencia sharing a meal.
cards.source_title: Cultural and Heritage Events | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Annual event held in late October or early November.

cards.title: Work Out at the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Free gym access for students in Power Hall
cards.notes: Access 3,300 square feet of cardio and weight equipment in Power Hall. Entry is free for all current students with a valid Dominican Star Card.
cards.short_summary: The Fitness Center in Power Hall offers free gym access to the Dominican University community.
cards.evidence_claim: The facility is open to all current Dominican University students, faculty, staff, and alums; a current Dominican University ID must be shown.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center - Facilities - Dominican University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open during posted hours; Star Card required for entry.
